Senate Bill 241 By: Senators Williams of the 25th, Anderson of the 24th, Mallow of the 2nd, Robertson of the 29th and Parent of the 44th AS PASSED
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 18 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to funeral directors and establishments, embalmers, and crematories, so as to provide for the organic human … county correctional institution or other county correctional facility."
PART III SECTION 3-1.
This Act shall become effective on July 1, 2025.
SECTION 3-2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
